face_design.name: 누리레느
face_design.why: 바다의 가수와 길게 흐르는 지느러미를 긴 얼굴와 완만한 긴 눈으로 해석한다.
cues: 몸 형태 fish → 눈 간격 눈 사이가 넓은
페어리 타입 → 눈썹 가늘고 완만한 곡선
face_design.adjusted: 다른 종과 넷 이상 겹쳐 원작 단서의 다음 후보로 옮김 — 눈썹 길고 바깥 아치가 선명한 → 가늘고 완만한 곡선
face_design.hair_why: ‘thin, transparent blue fin’·‘long light blue hair’(원작의 머리칼)·몸 형태 fish에서 웨이브 헤어(웨이브·곱슬) · 매우 긴 머리 · 커튼뱅 — 키요공에서 이어 같은 묶음
hair_cues: ‘thin, transparent blue fin’ → 헤어스타일 웨이브 헤어
‘long light blue hair’(원작의 머리칼) → 머리 길이 매우 긴 머리

face_reason: Elongated narrow face and long jaw echo the long lyrical fin silhouette; wide-set almond eyes and soft fine brows retain the water/fairy singer impression. Very long waves continue Brionne while lengthening the face compared with her.
final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): elongated face, long length, narrow width; long chin with defined jaw; almond eyes, medium size, downturned outer corners, wide-set; fine soft arches; balanced nose; full lips.
comparison_observation: Popplio has a broad short blue bob and round cheeks; Brionne has a shorter, rounder chin and more open eyes. Litten and Torracat have compact tapered faces and sharper upward eyes; Incineroar has stronger sharply angled red-brown eyes. Primarina has a longer lower face, softly downturned almond eyes and pale blue waves.
inventory_method: Read-only git ls-tree HEAD filename inventory supplied to os.listdir(img) for planner only; no unrelated image blob checkout, no repository tool edits.
anchor_identity: Same first light character; only erroneous extra silver digit locally removed. Creation references retain their actual original hashes.
original_policy: PNG and discarded edit images remain session-only. Records store exact prompts, actual UI state and hashes only.
